title: CHAM · Tân Lộc: eco-homestay project on Tân Lộc river island (Cần Thơ, Vietnam)
description:
CHAM is an eco-homestay project on Tân Lộc river island (Cần Thơ, Vietnam), first drafted by Đỗ Thùy Hương in 2017 as a Business Start-up course project during her bachelor’s in International Business, and rewritten in 2026 with Phan Anh Tú. This repository holds a public project description only; the full business plan and financials are not published.

Teaching case: bizonland.com/cham-homestay.html
